thread.title: The Dow Market Happenings For Friday, November 2, 2018

author: admin
title: The Dow Market Happenings For Friday, November 2, 2018
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Friday, November 2, 2nd, +175 points.
Thursday the Dow was up +264.98 (+1.06%) at 25,380.74.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.68%.
There were 21 Dow stocks up Thursday.
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by Intel (INTC) +2.86%, United Technologies (UTX) +2.71% and Home Depot (HD) +2.60%.
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by Verizon (VZ) -1.82%, McDonald’s (MCD) -1.14% and Microsoft (MSFT) -0.83%.
Apple (AAPL +1.54%) is down nearly 6% in premarket trading after it forecast Q1 revenue of $89 billion to $93 billion, the midpoint below consensus of $92.7 billion, and then said it will stop unit sales data for iPhones, iPads and Mac computers.
The economy added 250,000 jobs in October, the Labor Department said Friday. The unemployment rate was unchanged at 3.7 percent. Annual wage growth topped 3 percent for the first time in nine years. Economists had estimated 200,000 jobs were added last month.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended higher.
